source_contract_facts.agent_schedule_tombstone_path: OnSyncResponse deletes local schedule row, calls Scheduler.RemoveSchedule, then persists sync_state revision and commits before reloadSchedulerSchedules.

source_contract_facts.history_retention: Agent LocalStore execution table is separate from Script/Task/Schedule definition tables; postprobe will prove exact Execution remains rather than infer from source.
source_contract_facts.interval_semantics: Agent-owned Schedule is ticked by Native3 scheduler; interval=15s uses schedule CreatedAt until first fire, then lastFire anchor; exact observed first and next due times must be recorded, not inferred from configured interval alone.

risks_and_stop_conditions: Probe helper must discover exactly one regular state.db through the target Agent's /proc/PID/fd and verify same dev/inode before/after; ambiguity or absent FD is a safe stop.
